title: 根据政策资料包同步公告与上线清单
business_request: 请根据 docs 下的政策资料包，更新 docs/policy_notice.md 和 ops/policy_rollout_checklist.md，使公告与上线清单保持一致。
behavioral_checks: 公告与清单中的 audience、effective date、exception 和 escalation 必须与资料包保持一致。

acceptance_checks.name: policy-notice-check
command:
from pathlib import Path; expected = '# Policy Update
- audience: workspace admins
- effective_date: 2026-05-01
- rollout_window: staged over 14 days
- exception: legacy EU tenants stay on previous policy until migration completes
- escalation: trust-ops@example.test
'; current = Path('docs/policy_notice.md').read_text(encoding='utf8'); raise SystemExit(0 if current == expected else 1)

acceptance_checks.name: policy-checklist-check
command:
from pathlib import Path; expected = '# Rollout Checklist
- announce to workspace admins
- start staged rollout on 2026-05-01
- keep legacy EU tenants on previous policy until migration completes
- route escalations to trust-ops@example.test
'; current = Path('ops/policy_rollout_checklist.md').read_text(encoding='utf8'); raise SystemExit(0 if current == expected else 1)

notes: 适合作为 intake 入口示例，用来展示 context packing 对多文档任务的帮助。
